task.title: Custom board names and color themes
task.description:
Every workbook board just says "Repository Workbench / Workbook board" in the header and the color scheme is the same.
This is inconvenient for anyone using Workbook for more than one project because you can't tell the webpages apart.

Now that we have custom project config, we want to add some properties to it to change these. The config should allow a custom project name, and two custom project colors: primary and text.

First, as a default, the "Repository Workbench" text should change to say "Repository: <repo name>" where `repo name` is derived from the directory of the user (`git rev-parse --show-toplevel`).

When configured, the project name will display where the header currently says "Workbook board".

The Primary color replaces the current blue: rgb(36, 87, 214). The app should auto-generate complementary colors, for example the task header's rgb(213, 222, 234). The text color replaces the main rgb(23, 32, 51) for text.

Updating these values should be done under the `workbook config` command, with a web UI available on the current Statusus page, below the Status settings. The "Statuses" link should change to "Config".
